message: Could we set aside my outdated dog comparison, since the scene and carry-forward passage immediately before it both contained a bird? Would more thinking clarify why the feather-touch frightens and excites Whisker, or would trying a short revision give better evidence? Which detail deserves closer attention? What thinking or doing step do you choose next, and can you carry it out rather than list future steps? What observation would make you change that choice? What finding from the visible draft, remaining uncertainty, and unfinished next step will you carry into the following turn?
